item.title: A militant commander is killed by the Indian Armed Forces at a mosque in Kulgam district, Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir.
item.description:
A militant commander is killed by the Indian Armed Forces at a mosque in Kulgam district, Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir. He had escaped a shootout with troops two days earlier in a neighboring village, where his associate was killed.

Sources: AP

Topics: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir

item.title: In Kafrul, Dhaka, police fire around ten stun grenades against demonstrating garment workers following clashes with Bangladesh Nationalist Party activists who allegedly harassed female factory… / In Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, thousands of garment workers demanding a monthly minimum wage increase from ৳12,500 (US$100) to ৳30,000 ($240) block the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway and set…
item.description:
In Kafrul, Dhaka, police fire around ten stun grenades against demonstrating garment workers following clashes with Bangladesh Nationalist Party activists who allegedly harassed female factory employees, causing workers to stage demonstrations and halt production at several nearby garment factories.

Sources: The Business Standard

In Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, thousands of garment workers demanding a monthly minimum wage increase from ৳12,500 (US$100) to ৳30,000 ($240) block the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway and set fire to a police vehicle, causing police to fire tear gas and stun grenades in Gazipur and Ashulia as 55 factories close across the three areas, while police report around 300 arrests across 24 cases filed in Savar and Ashulia during the protests.

Sources: The Daily Star, The Daily Star

Topics: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests

item.description:
